description:
Write ideas for new videos: each a title, a thumbnail concept (one visible action)
    and the words to print, built on one to three real outliers (based_on, each with its
    video_id, title, multiple, find_id and bend niche when it came from another niche).
    constraints are rules every idea keeps (said in fits). band (10x, 5x, 2x) is the median
    multiple of the finds behind the idea, never a predicted view count. label: written by
    Hook Detector. 1 credit, refunded when the writing fails; fewer than 5 outliers known is
    422 too_few_outliers and costs nothing. Same as POST /v1/ideas; remix_find makes one
    find yours.

constraints.description: rules every idea keeps, up to 200 characters ("low budget")
constraints.title: Constraints

content_type.description: for a topic: long (default) or short
content_type.title: Content Type

idempotency_key.description: 1 to 255 visible ASCII characters; the same key and request within 24 hours answer the saved remix and charge nothing; the same key with another request is 422 idempotency_key_reused
idempotency_key.title: Idempotency Key

run_id.description: a finished Packaging or Long form run of yours: its finds, direct and bent, are the sources
run_id.title: Run Id

topic.description: the subject, 3 to 300 characters (the outliers come from the shared index); send this or run_id
topic.title: Topic

name: write_ideas
